name: HighlighterMarkup
description: An invented grounding checker that marks up model output the way a person would, in highlighter
intent: A page whose whole visual argument is annotation: text marked up in highlighter, struck through, underlined and pulled out into the margin, which is the product demonstrated rather than described.
